page.layout: One text column, right of centre, with a small italic marginal note in the left margin beside its lower lines. Running head at top centre, page number at top left, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: De harum autem Sectarum origine hæc habet, iis
quæ in superioribus ex AlSharestanio & AlGazalio ad-
duximus, consentanea, scil. sub Islamismi initiis nul-
las fuisse inter Mohammedis asseclas, controversias,
nisi de rebus quibusdam levioribus, لاتوجب
ايمانا quæ neque fidelem nec infidelem quempiam ولا
كفرا denominarent, deinde كان الخلاف يتدرج ويترقي شيا فشيا الي اخر ايام الصحابة حتي ظهرت معبد الجهني وغيلان الدمشقي ويونس الاسواري وخالفوا في
القدر واسناد جميع الاشيا الي تقدير الله ولم يزل الخلاف يتشعب والاراء يتفرق حتي تفرق اهل الاسلام واراب المقالات التي تلب[?] وسبعين فرقة Procedebat diffensio & crescebat paula-

l.i: donec apparerent Maabad Johamiensis, & Gilan Damasc-
enus, & Yunes (sive Jonas) Aswariensis; qui litem
moverunt de decreto divino, & nam omnia determina-
tioni Dei ascribenda, quæ subinde late se diffundere, inter
opinionum discrepantias non defiit, usque dum Illamis-
mi professores, & opinionum authores in 73 Sectas di-
visi sint. Mohammedis de hac inter suos sectarum va-
rietate vaticinium, inter ipsius miracula recensent,

main_text.l: cujus hoc celebratur apud eos dictum, ستفرق امتي ثلثا وسبعين فرقة كلها في
النار الا واحدة وهي ما انا عليه واصحابي Futurum est ut dividatur

l.i: populus meus in 73 Sectas, quæ omnes in ignem abitura
sunt, unâ tantum exceptâ, eâ scil. quam ipse jam &
sotii mei sequimur. Vet ut idem restert Sharestanius in 73.

marginalia.note: Aliis quidem verbis, sed eo-dem plane sensu habentur hæc apud Sharestanium præf.4.

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "تلب[?]" in the Arabic line before وسبعين; the Arabic words "يتدرج", "الاراء" and "الي" are read from a faint scan. "restert" is printed "restert" and is probably a misprint for "refert"; kept as printed with the long s made plain. "Vet" is printed and kept as printed for "Vel". "Illamismi" is printed and kept. "abitura" is read from "abitur" with a possible erased letter; check. Arabic lines are transcribed from a low-contrast scan and need checking by a reader of Arabic. The left marginal note stands beside the lines from "Procedebat" onward and is placed at that point in the text.
